environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 Web ACL with the following configuration: (1) A custom rule with priority 1 using a RegexPatternSet match on the 'category' query string parameter — the pattern set contains ^[a-zA-Z0-9 _-]{0,80}$ with BLOCK action on non-match (using NOT match scope with regex match). (2) A second rule at priority 2 with a SqliMatchStatement inspecting ALL_QUERY_ARGS with sensitivity level HIGH and text transformation URL_DECODE applied, action BLOCK. (3) The ECS task role has an IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/DenyNetworkEgress) that denies ec2:*, s3:GetObject, and all network-related actions preventing data exfiltration even if blind SQLi were somehow achieved. The Web ACL default action is ALLOW.

config.security_group: inbound 443 from ALB SG only, no outbound to internet
